scope_summary: Full OpenMalaria v50 modular Safe Rust library, CLI, and PyO3 Python package

opportunities.title: Uninitialized EIR accumulators in TransmissionModel
opportunities.description: tsAdultEIR_i, tsAdultEIR_l, surveyInputEIR_i/_l, and surveySimulatedEIR_i/_l are uninitialized in TransmissionModel constructor while surveyEIR() executes += on every warmup step (UB).

opportunities.title: Pre-main-sim EIR reset skipped due to init ordering
opportunities.description: transmission->summarize() is called before mon::initMainSim() when mon::isReported() is false, returning early at TransmissionModel.h:175 without zeroing warmup EIR accumulators.

opportunities.title: Copy-pasted assert(simulationMode == forcedEIR) in transientEIRknown
opportunities.description: Inside if (simulationMode == transientEIRknown), assert(simulationMode == forcedEIR) unconditionally aborts any debug build when transientEIRknown is active.

opportunities.title: Human::removeFromCohort leaves stale cohortSet bitmask
opportunities.description: subPopExp.erase(id) omits mon::updateCohortSet(cohortSet, id, false), leaving the cached cohortSet bitmask permanently stale for cohort monitoring.

opportunities.title: Pass-by-value lastPercent in print_progress & int32 overflow
opportunities.description: print_progress(int lastPercent, ...) takes lastPercent by value instead of reference so static lastPercent=-1 never updates, spamming stderr every step; sim::now()*100 also risks signed overflow.

opportunities.title: Divide-by-zero UB on missing interval and zero-adult step
opportunities.description: SimData::interval stays 0 when neither ModelName=base nor <parameters> is set, causing 365/0 integer UB; surveyEIR() also divides 0.0/0 when tsNumAdults == 0, poisoning surveySimulatedEIR with NaN.

opportunities.title: Infinite resampling loop when human weight multStdDev == 0
opportunities.description: When multStdDev == 0.0 (allowed by schema.xsd) and newborn mean weight < 0.5 kg, do-while resampling hetMassMultiplier >= minHetMassMult hangs forever in Release builds.

opportunities.title: Uninitialized fields in VivaxBrood::UpdResult & EventScheduler
opportunities.description: VivaxBrood::UpdResult() leaves isFinished uninitialized and ClinicalEventScheduler leaves previousDensity uninitialized.

opportunities.title: Eliminate 15+ process-wide mutable static singletons
opportunities.description: Encapsulate SimClock, MasterRng, Parameters, ModelOptions, Genotypes, Monitoring, and Interventions in instance-owned ScenarioContext & Simulation structs for multi-instance thread-safe Python execution.

opportunities.title: Eliminate ~400M hot-loop heap vector allocations & pointer chasing
opportunities.description: Replace per-human per-step std::vector<double> EIR/genotype heap allocations, 3 unique_ptr virtual dispatches, and raw std::list<CommonInfection*> with SoA population buffers, inline fixed-capacity slots, and pre-allocated scratch slices.

opportunities.title: Replace 1,188 raw pointer/malloc/static hazards with #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
opportunities.description: Eliminate raw malloc/free GSL matrix arrays, owning raw pointers in CommonWithinHost, and reinterpret_cast GSL RNG hooks via 100% Safe Rust crates.

opportunities.title: Decompose >600 LOC monoliths into <=400 LOC documented modules
opportunities.description: Split 7 oversized files (up to 960 lines) into focused <=400 LOC single-responsibility Rust modules with complete rustdoc and runnable doc-tests.

benchmarks.label: 1. Legacy C++20 Release Baseline (-O3)
benchmarks.notes: Median of 3 Release runs across 5 scenarios (VecFullTest, 2ITNs, Molineaux, Vivax, EffectiveDrug); 66/66 cxxtest passed.
